version.author: Diebanez
version.changelog: Script installers: a catalogue entry can ship a zip with an install script (install.ps1 / install.sh); such plugins are marked "unmanaged installer" and installing them asks for confirmation first. Action names everywhere match the Action list (Script: RPM_....lua).

version.author: Diebanez
version.changelog: New action Script: RPM_Browse.lua: browse the group's catalogue and install plugins without a project needing them. Only one install runs at a time across all RPM actions.

version.author: Diebanez
version.changelog: No restart needed after an install: RPM opens the FX browser, asks you to choose "Scan for new plugins", and offers to reload the project once it sees the new plugins. A restart remains the fallback.

version.author: Diebanez
version.changelog: After an install RPM offers to restart REAPER now: it quits REAPER (asking to save unsaved changes), starts it again and reopens the projects that were open. Replaces the FX-browser scan of 1.3.0.

version.name: 1.5.0-beta.1
version.author: Diebanez
version.changelog: macOS: a disk image holding a vendor app (such as UA Connect or the Spitfire Audio app) and no plugin installs that app into /Applications silently, asking for the administrator password only when the member cannot write there.
